title: Inflammatory bowel disease predicted effector genes in hypothalamic-like neurons (Lasconi C et al. 2021)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

Variant-to-Gene-Mapping Analyses Reveal a Role for the Hypothalamus in Genetic Susceptibility to Inflammatory Bowel Disease.
Lasconi C, et al.
Cell Mol Gastroenterol Hepatol. 2021;11(3):667-682. doi: 10.1016/j.jcmgh.2020.10.004.
PMID: 33069917

The authors prioritized potential IBD effector genes at 332 genetically associated loci from previously published IBD GWAS. They determined which sentinel SNPs and their LD proxies (r2 > 0.8) overlapped regions of open chromatin in human embryonic stem cell-derived hypothalamic-like neurons, and intersected those with regions that contacted open gene promoter regions, as determined by Capture-C, to prioritize the genes listed in the table below. Mouse over the column headers for more details about each evidence type.

See this page for IBD effector gene predictions in colonoids that were generated in this study.
